text:
The goal was simple:

I wanted to try Pi without rebuilding my whole model setup.

I already had OpenCodex (OCX) running as my local model proxy, so the plan was:

Pi → OCX → existing providers/models

Except Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor Free refused to cooperate.

The nice part: I didn't need to change the entire provider.

OCX supports per-model adapter routing.

So I added:

muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free → openai-responses

Everything else could keep using the existing adapter.
